title: GTM Engineer (Market Research)
description:
**About the Role** 




 Behind every SDR conversation is an account that had to be found first. Our Data Research team is the engine that makes that happen. As a GTM Engineer, you'll build Python\-based scrapers across e\-commerce marketplaces to surface high\-fit seller and brand accounts, then package them into clean, ready\-to\-work lists that go straight into our SDR team's hands. If you like the idea of writing code that directly fuels pipeline, this is the seat.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 




 ● Build Python\-based web scrapers and data collection pipelines across e\-commerce marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Meesho, Myntra, and similar)
 



 ● Enrich companies using APIs and AI to build a fuller picture of each account
 



 ● Automate lead sourcing for target ICPs, end to end
 



 ● Apply qualification logic and build account prioritization models to surface the best\-fit leads first
 



 ● Maintain clean, structured HubSpot data across all sourced accounts
 



 ● Develop internal automation tools that make SDRs faster and more effective
 



 ● Improve prospecting efficiency using AI, Python, and no\-code automation
 



 ● Work closely with SDRs and fellow data researchers to tighten ICP criteria based on lead quality feedback
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




 ● Solid hands\-on Python skills with real scraping experience (BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Selenium/Playwright, or similar)
 



 ● Comfort with APIs, request handling, and basic anti\-bot workarounds
 



 ● Exposure to AI tools/APIs for data enrichment or automation
 



 ● Working knowledge of data structuring; HubSpot familiarity is a plus
 



 ● Self\-starter energy — can turn "we need accounts in this category" into a working script without heavy oversight
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 Every account you surface is a direct input into SDR pipeline. This isn't a support function — it's the front end of how Unicommerce finds its next customers.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Join us as a "Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping, where you'll build analytical tools to generate insight, recognise patterns and predict behaviour, and deliver content direct to users of information products. You will work with technical teams, architects, designers, and administrators to overcome technical challenges and to make it happen. This role is responsible for supporting the design and delivery of end\-to\-end customer and colleague journey transformations across Barclays UK (BUK) Business Banking front \& back\-office operations and will contribute significantly to shaping Target Operating Models (TOMs) and eliminating process debt.
   

  

 The role is also responsible for ensuring the consistency and quality of process maps developed by journey mapping analysts, and for translating those maps into a business\-relevant narrative for wider stakeholder engagement providing a cohesive storyline of customer and colleague pain points, while identifying opportunities to deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, operational efficiency, and control effectiveness, in alignment with Barclays’ transformation strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Journey \& Process Design**
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Support high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management
* Oversee Customer Journey mapping analyst’s output (timeliness and overall quality)
* Provide support to Analysts by providing best\-practice guidance and conceptual support on journey mapping techniques, as required
* Integrate multiple journey variant maps to provide a consolidated view of related customer journeys
* Coordinate with stakeholders to obtain relevant data references that support effective journey visualisation
* Develop insightful visualizations that highlight customer pain points and identify opportunities to streamline processes and improve journey efficiency.


**Tooling \& Visualization**
* Use Figma, and Blueworks Live to map current and future state journeys.
* Maintain a centralised journey register and ensure traceability to customer outcomes and control requirements.


**Transformation Delivery \& Governance**
* Identify automation opportunities across journeys leveraging RPA, and AI/ML models
* Support the delivery of transformation initiatives, including business case development, benefit tracking, and stakeholder reporting.
* Ensure alignment with BUK’s transformation governance, including floorwalk showcases.


**To be successful as a "** 
**Senior Analyst \- Customer Journey Mapping" you should have experience with:**
**Essential Skills And Experience**
* Experience in Target Operating Model design and customer\-centric transformation delivery in Banking and financial services / Consulting / Global capability centers.
* Tooling: Expert level proficiency in Figma (UI/UX design), Blueworks Live (process mapping) and MS Power point (presentation and storytelling)
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable, and digitally enabled journeys.
* Drive high\-impact process optimization engagements that enhance efficiency, customer experience, and risk management.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate into actionable insights.
* Strong problem\-solving skills to identify pain points in the customer journey.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across global and cross\-functional teams.


**Preferred Skills**
- Prior experience of working in / with:

* agile transformation environments
* Customer Experience / product teams
* Familiarity with Design thinking concepts.
* Familiarity with automation and AI technologies (e.g. RPA \- UiPath / Celonis / BluePrism / Automation Anywhere, Salesforce \& Agentforce, CoPilot Studio, Amazon Bedrock GenAI).


 You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job\-specific technical skills.
   

  

 This role will be based out of Noida/Gurugram.
   

  

**Purpose of the role**
 To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Development and implementation of strategies to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of banking operations, using data led insights.
* Participation in projects and initiatives to improve performance \& optimisation efficiency and effectiveness.
* Development of reports and presentations on performance \& optimisation and communicate findings to internal senior stakeholders.
* Identification of industry trends and developments, and collaboration with stakeholders across the bank to provide recommendations for change and improvement within performance and optimisation processes.
* Development and implementation of analytics and reporting performance \& optimisation to mitigate risks and maintain efficient operations.
* Identification of capacity creation in operations using data and Management Information.


**Assistant Vice President Expectations**
* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub\-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.


 All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: Senior Manager- Risk Management
description:
**Job Description**
 How we serve our customers is constantly evolving and is a challenge we gladly accept. Whether you’re finding new ways to prevent identity fraud or enabling customers to start a new business, you can work with one of the most valuable data sets in the world to identify insights and actions that can have a meaningful impact on our customers and our business. And, with opportunities to learn from leaders who have defined the course of our industry, you can grow your career and define your own path. Find your place in risk and analytics on \#TeamAmex.
   

  

 How will you make an impact in this role?
   

  

 The Credit Risk Team helps enable profitable business growth by managing credit risk and maintaining portfolio resiliency within established risk appetite. You will work in a highly dynamic and exciting environment, with the opportunity to shape credit\-risk analytics and apply emerging capabilities such as Generative AI and Agentic AI to improve risk identification, portfolio monitoring, and analytical processes. The role will involve collaborating with teams across Risk, AI/ML, Technology, and the Business to develop insights and implement scalable solutions. To succeed in this role, you will need a strong blend of analytical and technical skills, innovative thinking, problem\-solving ability, and relationship\-building skills.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Identify and develop GenAI and Agentic AI use cases for credit\-risk analytics and processes, including analysis of structured and unstructured information, automated research, identification of risk drivers, and generation of actionable portfolio insights.
* Partner with AI/ML and Technology teams to prototype, test, and implement GenAI\- and Agentic\-AI\-enabled solutions, translating credit\-risk business problems into analytical requirements, assessing impact, conducting UAT, and supporting implementation.
* Drive automation and productivity improvements across credit\-risk analytics processes by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to repetitive analytical workflows, data gathering, portfolio monitoring, and investigative analysis.
* Perform portfolio analytics across Commercial portfolios to identify emerging risk trends, deterioration patterns, concentrations, and opportunities to improve portfolio performance.
* Evaluate external and third\-party data sources, including news and market intelligence, to assess their relevance and incremental value for portfolio analytics, risk identification, and strategy development.
* Monitor portfolio performance and conduct ongoing analytical reviews of risk trends, strategy effectiveness, and emerging areas of concern, providing insights and recommendations to business and risk partners.


**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of relevant experience in Credit Risk Management, Portfolio Risk Analytics, Credit Strategy, or a similar risk\-focused role, with demonstrated experience analyzing portfolio performance and developing risk insights or strategies.
* Degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Strong understanding of credit\-risk concepts, portfolio performance, delinquency and loss trends, risk segmentation, early\-warning indicators, and strategy evaluation.
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with experience analyzing large and complex datasets, identifying key risk drivers, and translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Experience developing or evaluating credit\-risk strategies using internal, external, and alternative data sources, with the ability to assess incremental value and business impact.
* Working knowledge of Generative AI, Large Language Models, and Agentic AI concepts, with the ability to identify and apply relevant use cases within credit\-risk analytics and processes; hands\-on experience with AI\-enabled analytical solutions is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to translate credit\-risk business problems into analytical or technology requirements and partner effectively across Risk, AI/ML, Technology, Product, and external vendors.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, communicate effectively with senior stakeholders, and mentor and develop team members in a dynamic, matrixed environment.
* Should be comfortable with rotational shift of 12\.00pm to 09\.00pm, 11\.00am to 08\.00pm, 08\.00am to 05\.00pm


**About Us**
 At American Express, our culture is built on a 175\-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world\-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
   

  

 As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well\-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We back you with benefits that support your holistic well\-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
   

  

* Competitive base salaries

* Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need

 American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

 What will your essential responsibilities include?

* Design, maintain and test scalable and reusable APIs using R and SQL facilitating seamless interaction between tools and data services within property pricing.

 AXA XL, the P\&C and specialty risk division of AXA, is known for solving complex risks. For mid\-sized companies, multinationals and even some inspirational individuals we don’t just provide re/insurance, we reinvent it.
   

  

 How? By combining a comprehensive and efficient capital platform, data\-driven insights, leading technology, and the best talent in an agile and inclusive workspace, empowered to deliver top client service across all our lines of business − property, casualty, professional, financial lines and specialty.

 AXA XL is committed to equal employment opportunity and will consider applicants regardless of gender, sexual orientation, age, ethnicity and origins, marital status, religion, disability, or any other protected characteristic.  AXA XL’s Reward program is designed to take care of what matters most to you, covering the full picture of your health, wellbeing, lifestyle and financial security. It provides competitive compensation and personalized, inclusive benefits that evolve as you do.

 At AXA XL, Sustainability is integral to our business strategy. In an ever\-changing world, AXA XL protects what matters most for our clients and communities. title: Manager - BCG Vantage
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path within BCG's Principal Investors and Private Equity (PIPE) Practice Area you will work in a growing global team, providing industry/functional expertise and insights whilst working together with case and proposal teams to provide knowledge assets, analysis and expert advisory. The team uses a variety of number of AI and advanced data analytics tools; and you will be expected to develop expertise on those. You’ll serve as a thought partner and content expert to case teams and topic/sector leaders, helping structure and solve complex issues.
   

  

 You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Manager – BCG Vantage, you will help build, own and enhance AI\-enabled products, tools and knowledge assets – taking them from problem definition through build, deployment on live cases, and adoption. You will work closely with case teams and business leaders to drive real usage and impact, while helping onboard, train and enable junior colleagues on your topic/sector and on new products.
   

  

 BCG’s PIPE Practice Area works with the world’s largest investment firms, serving six client asset classes: Private Equity, Hedge Funds, Infrastructure \& Real Estate Funds, Family Offices, Sovereign Wealth Funds and Pension Plans. Likewise, PIPE topics cut across not only these asset classes, but also across industries (e.g., Health Care, Consumer, Technology, etc.) and sub\-topics (e.g., Tech Capital, Private Credit, Environmental, Social and Governance, etc.)
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 3\+ years consulting experience in PIPE required; candidates with consulting experience preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 4\+ years minimum industry experience required; 6\-10\+ years of industry experience strongly preferred
* Bachelor's Degree required (advanced degree preferred)
* Fluency in English;
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills to interact with internal and external stakeholder while working in a global collaborative team environment
* Practical fluency with GenAI and modern development tools (e.g. APIs, custom GPTs / AI Skills, coding assistants such as Claude Code or Cursor, GitHub, cloud platforms) strongly preferred; comfort learning new tools as the landscape evolves
* Demonstrated experience managing product roadmaps, backlog prioritization, and cross\-functional stakeholder alignment, with comfort in data\-driven decision making and familiarity with agile/scrum delivery frameworks


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 As a Manager – BCG Vantage on our Topic Activation path, you will collaborate with global topic leads and colleagues across BCG to bring expertise and capabilities to the service of our internal and external clients.
   

  

 Our team is made up of a diverse pool of BCG Vantage positions that allow us to pursue exciting, innovative BCG Vantage careers.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

**YOU'RE GOOD AT**
* Solving complex client problems through relevant analytical approaches and customized solutions in one or more relevant PIPE topic areas
* Communicating with senior stakeholders, demonstrating the ability to engage your audience effectively
* Demonstrating rapid learning agility across emerging technologies and analytical assets to enhance analysis, develop products, and create scalable, repeatable research and knowledge frameworks
* Managing a portfolio of projects, with strong awareness of business priorities and commercial impact
* Owning the end\-to\-end lifecycle of AI\-enabled products and analytics assets – from problem definition and roadmap through prototyping, build, deployment on live cases, adoption tracking, and ongoing enhancement
* Training, coaching, and mentoring junior team members
* Working in an ever changing and complex environment, and comfortable with ambiguity and navigating a fast\-paced environment


**Additional Information**
 BCG Vantage is a powerhouse of expertise, seamlessly embedded within Practice Areas and markets to drive extraordinary impact. It equips BCG case teams and clients with cutting\-edge expertise, proprietary assets, actionable data, and transformative insights that empower our case teams and enable our clients to achieve their aspirations.
   

  

 With global experts across 20 Practices, covering more than 100 topics, sectors and offers, plus four focused geographic markets, BCG Vantage delivers unparalleled depth and breadth of insight \& expertise. BCG Vantage consists of three career paths, each playing a crucial role in delivering value to clients, case teams and practice teams.
   

  

***Client Focus (Embedded Expertise)***
* Integrates into client\-facing teams to deliver direct client impact through expertise, know\-how, and proprietary tools and assets


***Topic Activation (Sector Expertise with Proprietary Tool \& Data Solutions)***
* Combines deep domain insights with our know\-how and proprietary assets to address targeted challenges directly with clients and project teams; co\-creates insights on industry trends and functional topics, proprietary data and tools, and teams to codify IP that all enables BCG to deliver excellent business value with its clients


***Research (Practice Topic and Sector\-Aligned Research and Insights)***
* Delivers actionable research and insights tailored to the client project’s needs; works with qualitative and quantitative data, conducts research and provides synthesized results from sources including commercial data, public and open source, company and industry research, macro\-economic, commodities and trade data.


 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: AI Platform Engineer
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:**

**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Product Insight Analyst – Toys & Games.
description:
**About Us** 





 Smartivity is India's leading STEM toy brand, founded in 2015 by IIT Delhi engineers. We make screen\-free wooden DIY kits for kids aged 3–14\. We have 130\+ products, 10M\+ kits sold, and 163\+ patents filed. We design and manufacture everything in\-house in Manesar.
 




  





**The Role** 





 Trends come and go. Great toy brands are built on bets that last. You'll help Smartivity decide where to play over the next 3–5 years: which categories to enter, which product platforms to build, and which shifts in how children learn and play we should get ahead of. Along the way, you'll build \*Smartivity's product discovery playbook\*, a repeatable, data\-backed way of spotting, testing, and prioritising opportunities that the whole team can use long after any single trend fades.
 




  





**What You'll Do** 





 \-
 
**Build the playbook** 

 : Create Smartivity's documented system for product discovery: the data sources we trust, the criteria an idea must meet, how we size and score opportunities, and how we learn from every launch. You'll refine it each quarter as our bets play out.
 





 \-
 
**Track structural shifts** 

 : Study the forces reshaping kids' play and learning: screen\-time concerns, NEP 2020 and the push for hands\-on STEM, changing family income and gifting habits, sustainability, and the growth of new markets.
 





 \-
 
**Build category theses** 

 : Develop evidence\-backed views on the categories and age bands Smartivity should own, enter, or avoid over the long term, with sizing, growth outlook, and competitive dynamics.
 





 \-
 
**Think in platforms** 

 : Identify product systems that can grow into families of products over years, rather than one\-off SKUs, and that build on our patents and manufacturing strengths.
 





 \-
 
**Separate signal from noise** 

 : Use search, marketplace, and social data to test whether a trend is a fad or an early sign of lasting change.
 





 \-
 
**Listen at scale** 

 : Analyse reviews, complaints, and our part\-replacement and returns data to find unmet needs that persist over time.
 





 \-
 
**Watch the frontier** 

 : Monitor global toy launches, patent filings, and research on child development to see where play is heading.
 





 \-
 
**Shape the roadmap** 

 : Feed a long\-term opportunity map and quarterly category deep\-dives into the product team's planning.
 




  





**Tools You'll Use** 





 \-
 
**Market and category data** 

 : Circana (NPD), Euromonitor, Statista, industry and investor reports
 





 \-
 
**Demand and trend signals:** 

 Google Trends, Amazon Brand Analytics, Jungle Scout, Keepa, Exploding Topics
 





 \-
 
**Competitive and IP landscape** 

 : Google Patents, Similarweb, Meta Ad Library
 





 \-
 
**Analysis** 

 : SQL, Google Sheets, LLM tools (Claude, ChatGPT)
 





 \-
 
**Visualisation:** 

 Looker Studio or Power BI
 




  





**What We're Looking For** 





 \- A graduate in engineering, economics, business, or another quantitative field, with 0–3 years in analytics, research, consulting, or a startup.
 





 \- Strong Excel/Sheets skills. Python or SQL is a big plus.
 





 \- Structured, long\-horizon thinking: you can build a thesis, test it with data, and change your mind when the evidence does.
 





 \- Product taste and genuine curiosity about how kids learn and play.
 





 \- The ability to turn research into a crisp, confident recommendation.
 





 \- Experience with any of the tools above is a plus. How you think matters more than what you've used.
 




  






 Why Join
 





 You'll help decide what a patent\-driven, in\-house\-manufacturing brand becomes over the next five years, and build the playbook it uses to get there.
 




  






 Interested candidates can share their CVs at sakshi@smartivity.in

* Experience working with large datasets, data preparation and feature engineering.
* Ability to independently manage end\-to\-end model development assignments.

**Preferred qualifications** 



* Experience in banking or financial services, particularly marketing analytics.
* Experience developing customer propensity, acquisition, cross\-sell, retention or campaign response models.
* Familiarity with model governance, monitoring and documentation requirements.
* Experience working with US\-based business stakeholders.

description:
**About Us**
 Innovation. Sustainability. Productivity. This is how we are Breaking New Ground in our mission to sustainably advance the noble work of farmers and builders everywhere. With a growing global population and increased demands on resources, our products are instrumental to feeding and sheltering the world.
   

  

 From developing products that run on alternative power to productivity\-enhancing precision tech, we are delivering solutions that benefit people – and they are possible thanks to people like you. If the opportunity to build your skills as part of a collaborative, global team excites you, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**Grow a Career. Build a Future!**
 Be part of this company at the forefront of agriculture and construction, that passionately innovates to drive customer efficiency and success. And we know innovation can’t happen without collaboration. So, everything we do at CNH Industrial is about reaching new heights as one team, always delivering for the good of our customers.
   

  

**Job Purpose**
* Lead the risk management function for financial services in the AANZ region. The portfolio approximates $2 billion covering retail (including portfolios with partners), wholesale, and trade finance. The position provides specific risk support across all major markets (including Australia, India, and China) and business segments. The position will report to the Global Risk team and work closely with the regional credit, commercial lending and finance teams as well as the respective Country Managers in assessing, monitoring and managing risk. The position is additionally responsible for managing and supporting resources with modelling and analytics capability.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Perform portfolio risk analysis and maintain key risk metrics covering credit quality, delinquencies, losses, reserves, and cost of risk.
* Manage loss forecasting, reserve analyses, and CECL/US GAAP support, including budgeting and forecasting activities.
* Conduct country, regional, and macroeconomic risk assessments to identify emerging risks and opportunities.
* Develop, implement, and monitor credit risk scorecards (origination, behavioral, collections) and automated decision strategies using advanced analytics and AI/ML techniques.
* Lead the development, validation, and performance monitoring of risk models and decision tools across underwriting, collections, and portfolio management.
* Support digital transformation initiatives through automation, AI\-driven solutions, and enhancements to credit processes and systems.
* Deliver data\-driven insights and ad hoc analyses to support strategic business initiatives and risk mitigation efforts.
* Benchmark risk performance, policies, and practices against industry peers and market standards.
* Develop and maintain risk policies, governance frameworks, controls, and best practices across regions.
* Support new business initiatives, growth strategies, and product development through risk assessment and analytics.
* Promote knowledge sharing and consistency of risk methodologies across global teams.


**Experience Required**
 7\+ years of experience in credit risk management, portfolio analytics, and predictive modeling.
   

  

**Preferred**
* Experience in capital goods, equipment finance, or captive finance industry, with an understanding of dealer networks, distribution channels, and end\-customer financing dynamics.
* Knowledge of agricultural and construction equipment markets.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decision\-making and drive alignment across a global, matrixed organization.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Postgraduate degree in quantitative discipline such as Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, or Computer Science.
* Strong expertise in Azure Databricks, SAS, Python, and cloud\-based analytics platforms.
* Proven track record of developing, implementing, and monitoring predictive models, scorecards, AI/ML solutions, and data\-driven decision frameworks.
* Ability to translate complex analytical findings into actionable business insights and strategic recommendations.


**What We Offer**
 We offer dynamic career opportunities across an international landscape. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to delivering value for all our employees and fostering a culture of respect.
   

  

**Benefits**
 At CNH, we understand that the best solutions come from the diverse experiences and skills of our people. Here, you will be empowered to grow your career, to follow your passion, and help build a better future. To support our employees, we offer regional comprehensive benefits, including:
   

  

* Flexible work arrangements
* Savings \& Retirement benefits
* Tuition reimbursement
* Parental leave
* Adoption assistance
* Fertility \& Family building support
* Employee Assistance Programs
* Charitable contribution matching and Volunteer Time Off

description:
Responsible for management, analysis and reporting of conference production financial and future planning data, including expense templates, roll ups, growth projections, financial dashboard, calendar dashboard, and attendee heatmap dashboard. The successful candidate will also provide analysis and actionable reports to aid senior leadership decision making as well as future venue sourcing \& capacity planning.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities:**
* Build, manage, and continuously improve 600\+ complex and cross\-linked templates, including multiple critical global roll\-ups across excel and Power BI that are used for managing expenses across the entire conferences business
* Project manage budget timelines to ensure templates are replicated in line with key planning milestones tied to larger financial commitments, ensuring we are driving decisions to maximize conference contribution.
* Maintain and improve Conference Production Financial Dashboards, Global Conferences Calendar Dashboard, and Conferences Attendee Heatmap Dashboard in Power BI. Data aggregation and cleaning, power queries, data modelling, Power BI visualization design, programming in DAX, and mapping to Smartsheet.
* Construct Financial Projections models to include Scenario Analysis and Growth Curve Analysis. Investigate current best practices for predictive data modelling, using Python or other programming language.
* Design and build from start to finish complex analytic models and tools to support global team, utilizing advanced Excel and VBA modelling skills.
* Support global team, building conference planning tools from scratch, including problem solving the most effective solutions and training team as required, enabling production team to efficiently analyze large amounts of data \& make crucial event planning decisions.
* Partner with stakeholders and other team members to identify data analytics requirements. Identify and implement most effective and efficient solution.
* Proactively identify opportunities to automate processes. Use advanced VBA programming, MS Power Automate to automate manual Excel processes to realize significant time savings and reduction in errors.
* Demonstrate the ability to rapidly evaluate, learn and implement modern automation technologies (Power Automate, Python, AI\-enabled workflows in line with Gartner AI governance policies, Power Automate and SharePoint integration) to improve operational efficiency, scalability, and user experience.

* Create and maintain comprehensive documentation, process maps, solution architectures, and knowledge\-transfer materials to ensure scalability, continuity, and adoption of analytical tools.

description:
**Join a Team That’s Passionate About Making Lives Better!**
 At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that success starts with an amazing team. We are a global leader in outsourcing solutions, we focus on making lives better, one connection at a time. We provide tailored solutions to businesses around the globe, specializing in customer care, sales, and financial services. We’re looking for enthusiastic, driven individuals to join our dynamic work environment where
 *fun meets results* 
 !
   

  

 Bill Gosling Outsourcing Corp.The Assistant Manager – Business Insights will assist in leading and managing projects aimed at improving business processes and systems. This role involves working closely with different departments to analyze current processes, identify areas for improvement, and develop and implement solutions that enhance efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Opportunity identification on the ground: Continuously scan the operations to surface improvement avenues, inefficiencies, and performance gaps, and maintain a prioritized pipeline of opportunities backed by data and operational evidence.
* Problem framing: Partner with the account team and functional owners to convert vague asks and observed pain points into sharp, scoped problem statements with clear business impact and decision needs.
* Diagnostics \& root\-cause analysis: Run structured deep dives using data analysis, process walkthroughs, floor observation, segmentation, and Lean Six Sigma methods to move from symptoms to underlying drivers.
* Analysis \& optimization: Build and maintain the analysis that drives decisions on the account — performance trends, driver analysis, and scenario comparisons — and translate findings into concrete optimization actions.
* Data \& analytical quality: Validate data availability, definitions, and reliability; reconcile conflicting sources; document assumptions and limitations; and assure the accuracy and reproducibility of analytical outputs.
* Solution enablement \& implementation support: Shape practical recommendations and support their implementation on the ground — coordinating owners, timelines, and dependencies so improvements are actually executed.
* Commercial \& account insight: Connect findings to account economics — productivity, cost\-to\-serve, SLA/KPI exposure, quality, and client\-impact implications.
* Technology \& process enablement: Identify where recurring problems can be addressed through dashboards, trackers, automation, or process redesign; define clear requirements and partner with development resources on delivery.
* Adoption \& impact tracking: Establish baselines, track adoption and action closure, and measure before/after business impact so improvements stick and benefits are evidenced.
* Reporting \& decision support: Translate analysis into concise, decision\-ready narratives and flags for account reviews and for the Assistant Manager / Manager, Business Insights.


**Why Join Us?**
* Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and providing opportunities for career advancement.
* Comprehensive Training: We offer extensive paid training to ensure you’re equipped for success.
* Team\-Oriented Culture: Work in a collaborative, supportive environment with peers who are passionate about what they do.
* Diversity \& Inclusion: We celebrate the unique perspectives and contributions of all our employees.
* Fun Workplace: Join a vibrant team that knows how to have fun! From team engagement activities to social events, we foster a lively and inclusive work environment where you’ll build strong connections.
* State\-of\-the\-Art Offices: Work in our modern, well\-equipped offices designed to enhance collaboration and productivity.
* Rewarding Work: Help businesses grow while making a real difference in people’s lives!


**Get to Know Us Better!** 
 Follow us to get an insider view of our team in action, our values in motion, and a sneak peek into what makes us an awesome place to work!

 Facebook: Bill Gosling Outsourcing
   

  

 LinkedIn: Bill Gosling Outsourcing
   

  

 Website – https://www.billgosling.com/careers
   

  

 By applying to this position, you acknowledge that you have read and understood Bill Gosling Outsourcing’s privacy policy here\- https://www.billgosling.com/privacy\-policy and consent to the collection, use, and storage of personal information in accordance with the policy.
   

  

*At Bill Gosling Outsourcing, we believe that diversity makes us stronger. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone can thrive. Regardless of your race, gender, age, ability status, or any other characteristic, you are valued here.*

title: Research Engineer, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Engineer, AI** 
 to build the models and systems that make visa processing faster, more accurate and more reliable than ever before.
   

  

 You'll take ideas from research to production, testing new approaches across LLMs, agents and document intelligence, and shipping the ones that move real outcomes like approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with a strong engineering foundation who loves going deep on hard AI problems, and who gets as much satisfaction from a system that works in production as from a clever idea.
   

  

**The Job**
* Build AI systems that do real work by designing and shipping LLM\-powered agents that reliably complete complex, multi\-step tasks across external tools, APIs and web interfaces.
* Push the frontier of document intelligence by building pipelines that extract, verify and reason over information from unstructured documents and images with high accuracy at scale.
* Define how we measure AI quality by building evaluation frameworks, benchmarks and datasets that show how accurate, reliable and safe our models are across the long tail of real\-world cases, before and after they ship.
* Run experiments that change decisions by comparing models, prompting strategies, fine\-tuning approaches and routing logic to improve accuracy while reducing latency and cost.
* Own systems end to end by taking work from prototype to production, including data pipelines, inference infrastructure, monitoring and human\-in\-the\-loop fallbacks for when models aren’t confident.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 3\-6 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful work building and shipping ML or LLM\-based systems in production.
* Are exceptionally strong in Python and comfortable with the modern AI stack, such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, LLM APIs, vector databases and agent frameworks.
* Have hands\-on experience with LLMs in practice, including prompting, RAG, fine\-tuning, tool use and evals, and understand where each approach works and where it breaks.
* Bring a research mindset with a bias to ship: you form hypotheses, run clean experiments, read papers when they help, and turn results into systems people use.
* Have exposure to document AI, OCR, large\-scale data pipelines, or making inference fast and cost\-efficient at scale.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.
   

  

**Come build the intelligence layer for global travel**

title: Research Scientist, AI
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We're building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we've processed visas for 1M\+ travellers across 127 countries. But we're still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for a
 **Research Scientist, AI** 
 to invent the methods that make our AI systems more accurate, more reliable and more autonomous than anything available off the shelf.
   

  

 You'll work on the hardest open problems in our stack: agents that act reliably across unfamiliar government portals, models that reason over messy real\-world documents, and systems that know when they don't know. You'll set the research direction, run careful experiments and partner with our Research Engineers to turn breakthroughs into production gains in approval rates, turnaround times and cost per application.
   

  

 This role is for someone with deep research expertise who is energised by problems that don't have a paper to copy yet, and who measures success by real\-world impact, not just benchmark scores.
   

  

**The Job**
* Set and drive a research agenda on open problems in agentic AI, including how LLM\-powered agents plan, use tools, take actions and recover from errors over long, multi\-step tasks.
* Develop new methods for multimodal understanding and reasoning, so models can reliably extract, verify and reason over noisy, unstructured real\-world inputs across formats and languages.
* Design and run post\-training research, including fine\-tuning, preference optimisation and reinforcement learning, to push model capabilities beyond what general\-purpose frontier models offer.
* Research calibration, uncertainty estimation and self\-verification so AI systems know when to act autonomously and when to defer to a human.
* Build evaluations, benchmarks and synthetic data methods that give an honest picture of model quality, robustness and failure modes, especially on the long tail.
* Collaborate closely with research engineers to take ideas from prototype to production, and share findings through internal write\-ups and, where appropriate, publications.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You'll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have a PhD or MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning or a related field, or equivalent research experience, plus 3\+ years of applied or academic research in ML, NLP or computer vision.
* Have a track record of original research, such as publications at top venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP, CVPR), influential open\-source work, or research that clearly moved production metrics.
* Have deep hands\-on experience with LLMs beyond prompting, including fine\-tuning, RLHF/DPO or other post\-training methods, evaluation design, and a strong grasp of why models succeed or fail.
* Are strong in Python and PyTorch, and can run experiments yourself, from data curation and training runs to careful analysis.
* Bring rigour with a bias to impact: you ask sharp questions, design clean experiments, avoid fooling yourself, and care about whether the result changes what we build.


**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here's What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment, software and compute for your research.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you'll probably thrive here. If it doesn't, it's better to know that upfront.

title: Lead: Unit Economics & NPV Strategy
description:
**Description**
 About The Company
   

  

 FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.
   

  

 In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point\-of\-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices.
   

  

 Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state\-of\-the\-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents. FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities.
   

  

 We operate at massive scale, move fast, and expect leaders to think in systems, not silos. Decisions are data\-driven, accountability is explicit, and impact matters.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of how FairMoney decides
 **who to lend to, how much to lend, at what price, and why** 
 .
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are hiring a
 **Lead: Unit Economics \& NPV Strategy** 
 to own, improve, and operationalise FairMoney’s existing NPV and unit economics frameworks and ensure they become a core operating system for decision\-making, not just analytical artefacts.
   

  

 While FairMoney already has NPV models in place, they are not yet consistently embedded into credit decisions, pricing, experimentation, and growth trade\-offs. This role exists to close that gap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will be the single source of truth on
 **value creation vs value destruction** 
 , expected vs actual performance, and the economic impact of risk, pricing, and growth decisions.
   

  

 This is a senior, high\-ownership role for someone who pushes the bar, challenges assumptions, and thrives in a high\-growth, high\-pressure environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Own NPV \& Unit Economics: Own, audit, and improve NPV and unit economics models across lending products, ensuring consistent assumptions and decision\-ready outputs for pricing, credit cut\-offs, and capital allocation.
* Measure Expected vs Actual Performance: Build frameworks to measure performance across products, cohorts, credit policies, pricing strategies, and experiments, identifying key drivers of variance and feeding insights back into risk and pricing decisions.
* Drive Experimentation \& Value Attribution: Partner with Risk, Data Science, Product, and Growth to define NPV hypotheses, measure incremental economic value, and identify which initiatives should be scaled, improved, or stopped.
* Influence Business Decisions: Translate complex economic analysis into clear trade\-offs and provide credible insights to senior leadership, challenging models, policies, and decisions when the economics do not support them.
* Embed NPV in Decision\-Making: Integrate NPV thinking into credit policy reviews, risk governance, pricing and limit discussions, and planning cycles, while setting standards for transparency, documentation, and assumption discipline.
* Raise the Analytical Bar: Operate with high ownership and integrity, challenge analytical and execution standards, stay adaptable under pressure, and contribute to FairMoney’s mission of providing responsible access to credit.


**Requirements**
 Must\-Haves
   

  

* Strong experience in unit economics, NPV, LTV, or portfolio profitability (lending, fintech, banking, or adjacent sectors).
* Deep understanding of credit economics and how risk, pricing, tenure, and behaviour interact.
* Proven track record of measuring expected vs actual outcomes.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders using data and logic.
* High ownership mindset with bias toward action.


 Nice\-To\-Have
   

  

* Experience in high\-growth fintech or scale\-up environments.
* Exposure to experimentation frameworks (A/B testing, policy tests, pricing tests).
* Strong SQL / Python / analytics tooling capability.
* Experience working closely with Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams.


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

 By Month 3
   

  

* Existing NPV models are audited, rationalised, and standardised.
* A portfolio\-level NPV view exists across all major products.
* Leadership has clear visibility into where value is created or destroyed.
* Experiments are routinely evaluated on NPV uplift versus control.


 By Month 6
   

  

* NPV actively drives decisions on:
* Credit cut\-offs
* Pricing bands
* Growth investment trade\-offs
* Gaps between expected and actual performance are measured, explained, and shrinking.
* Risk, Data Science, and Growth teams operate using a shared economic language.
* Leadership trusts NPV outputs enough to make difficult, high\-impact decisions.


 Final Note
   

  

 This is not a passive analytics role.
   

  

 We are looking for someone who is comfortable challenging assumptions, pushing for clarity, and holding the line on economic truth — even when it is inconvenient.
   

  

 If you are motivated by scale, complexity, ownership, and impact, this role will stretch you and reward you.
   

  

**Benefits**
* Paid Time Off
* Training \& Development
* Flexible work structure


**Recruitment Process**
* A screening call with a member of the recruitment team.
* Technical interview with the hiring manager.
* Case study round.
* Panel session based on the case study.

title: Lead Engineer - Data & AI Platform
description:
**Role:** 
 Lead Data \& AI Platform Engineer
 



**Function:** 
 Data Engineering / AI/ML Platform
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi
 



**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Industry:** 
 Media Production, Broadcast Media, Online Media
 



  





**About Company** 




 The company is one of India's largest private FM radio networks. It reaches over 40 million listeners weekly across 49 cities, 1,000\+ towns, and 50,000 villages.
 



 It is the only private FM station broadcasting from Jammu \& Kashmir, with an international presence in Singapore and Bhutan. Its digital platform extends the brand into curated lifestyle, music, and news content.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of legacy broadcast media and digital innovation, with a team of 740\.
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 The company is building a next\-generation media super\-app that unifies video, audio, radio, micro\-drama, news, and commerce on a single digital platform. This role owns the scalable data and ML infrastructure powering content discovery, personalised recommendations, and user engagement at scale. The engineer in this role bridges production data systems and AI/ML teams, moving models from experimentation into reliable, high\-throughput production environments.
 



  





**Role \& Responsibilities** 



* Design and build scalable data architecture for a high\-volume consumer media platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving layers for user activity, content consumption, and commerce data.
* Build and maintain batch and real\-time streaming pipelines processing millions of user events and large volumes of multimedia metadata using technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Architect data lakes, warehouses, and analytical datasets supporting product analytics, reporting, and AI/ML use cases; enforce data quality, lineage, observability, and governance across all pipelines.
* Develop feature engineering pipelines and reusable feature stores for recommendation, personalisation, ranking, search, and content intelligence systems.
* Build training and inference pipelines connecting production data with ML models; enable continuous feedback loops for model retraining from live user interactions.
* Deploy ML/AI models into production on AWS, GCP, or Azure; containerise and orchestrate model workloads using Docker and Kubernetes; build APIs/services for consumer\-facing AI integration.
* Monitor model and pipeline performance — latency, scalability, reliability — and partner with AI/ML teams to operationalise models from experimentation to production.



  





**Must Have Criteria** 



* 7–9 years of hands\-on software or data engineering experience, with a track record of building and operating large\-scale data platforms.
* Strong proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala for data and ML pipeline development.
* Production experience with distributed data processing and streaming technologies such as Spark, Kafka, Flink, or Airflow.
* Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based data infrastructure on AWS, GCP, or Azure, including data lakes, warehouses, and distributed storage.
* Demonstrated experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments, including batch and real\-time inference pipelines.
* Proficiency with Docker and Kubernetes for containerising and orchestrating model and pipeline workloads.
* Strong understanding of data architecture, distributed systems, and data modelling for both analytical and ML use cases.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience building data infrastructure for recommendation, personalisation, search, or content ranking systems.
* Exposure to feature stores, MLOps platforms, and ML training/inference workload management.
* Prior experience on high\-scale B2C or consumer internet platforms handling behavioural and event\-streaming data.
* Background in media, OTT, video, audio, music, social media, gaming, or news platforms.
* Exposure to Generative AI, embeddings, vector databases, or LLM\-based applications.



  





**What We Offer** 



* End\-to\-end ownership of data and AI platform infrastructure for a consumer product reaching tens of millions of users.
* Opportunity to work at the convergence of broadcast media and digital innovation on a greenfield super\-app build.
* Collaborative environment with AI/ML, product, and engineering teams working on high\-impact personalisation and content intelligence problems.

title: Data Scientist- Operations
description:
**Role And Impact**
 Are you passionate about turning data\-driven ideas into robust, real\-world solutions? As an operations\-oriented Data Scientist at Topsoe, you will be at the heart of our digital transformation, ensuring our advanced analytics products deliver tangible value to customers every day. This is not a purely research or machine\-learning role—here, you will see your work come to life in production environments, making a direct impact on how our customers operate and succeed.
   

  

**In This Dynamic Position, Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop and optimize Python\-based solutions, automating manual and Excel\-driven processes to boost efficiency
* Take full ownership of the codebase, ensuring our digital products are reliable, maintainable, and ready for real\-world challenges
* Operate and run Clearview, our flagship digital product, supporting its evolution from development to robust, scalable operation
* Collaborate closely with Technical Service Engineers, customer experts, and stakeholders to deliver analytics solutions that work seamlessly in customer environments
* Troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent operational issues, using your expertise to drive continuous improvement
* Define and validate telemetry and data requirements, ensuring our solutions are data\-rich and insight\-driven
* Champion best practices in documentation, process improvement, and customer support, helping us set new standards for operational excellence


 This role is perfect for someone who thrives at the intersection of data science, software development, and product operations. You will see the direct results of your work, help shape the future of our digital offerings, and play a vital role in our customers’ success stories. If you are excited by the idea of making a measurable impact and being a key player in a collaborative, innovative team, we want to hear from you!
   

  

**What You Will Bring**
 We are looking for candidates who are ready to make a difference from day one. You will bring:
   

  

* A relevant academic degree, such as a Master of Science (M.Sc.) in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Chemical or Process Engineering, Software Engineering, or a similar technical or quantitative discipline
* Strong Python development skills, with hands\-on experience in debugging, maintaining, and supporting operational solutions
* A track record in data science and supporting or operating production or customer\-facing systems
* The drive and confidence to take ownership of a complete codebase and see projects through to successful operation
* Experience troubleshooting and maintaining deployed analytical or digital solutions
* A structured, practical approach to solving operational challenges
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and with customers
* Curiosity and enthusiasm for learning about chemical and process engineering


 It will be an added advantage if you have any experience in :
   

  

* Data engineering and Extract, Transform, Load (ETL)
* Spark or Databricks
* Docker or Kubernetes
* SQL or NoSQL databases
* Dashboards or web\-based analytical tools
* Cloud platforms and DevOps practices
* Customer\-facing digital products or industrial systems


 We value ownership, accountability, and a hands\-on, solution\-oriented mindset. If you are ready to step up and help shape the future of digital operations, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Why Join Us**
 At Topsoe, you will join a vibrant, forward\-thinking environment where your ideas and expertise are valued. This is your chance to combine data science and Python development with real operational ownership, working on products that make a difference for customers around the world. You will collaborate with talented colleagues, learn from industry leaders, and have the freedom to innovate and grow. We offer continuous learning, professional development, and the satisfaction of seeing your work drive real\-world impact. Join us and be part of a team that is shaping the future of sustainable technology.
   

  

**Your New Team**
 You will become part of a close\-knit data science group of around six dedicated professionals who have built Clearview from the ground up. As we shift our focus to reliable operation, customer support, and ongoing product improvement, you will have the opportunity to work across data science, Python development, product operations, and customer collaboration. Your contributions will be valued, your voice will be heard, and your work will help ensure our solutions deliver stable, practical value in real\-world environments.
   

  

**How You Can Apply**
 If you would like to be part of a team of skilled and professional colleagues in an informal organization, please submit your documents in English.
   

  

 Application deadline: 22\-10\-2026\.
   

  

 You do not need to attach a cover letter to your application – just include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are applying. Please also avoid the use of photos in your CV. Both of these measures are to ensure a fair and unbiased process.
   

  

 We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, irrespective of their gender, age, religion, disability, ethnic background, and geographical location. We encourage individuals from diverse cultures and countries to apply and contribute to our global team.
   

  

 To ensure a secure and trustworthy work environment, our recruitment process may include background checks, requests for criminal records, and contact with references.
   

  

 To headhunters: Thank you for your interest in our company. However, we would like to inform you that we have a dedicated internal team managing our recruitment process. We kindly request that you refrain from reaching out to us regarding potential candidates. Thank you for your understanding.
   

  

**About Us**
 Topsoe is a leading global provider of advanced technology and solutions for the energy transition.
   

  

 Built on decades of scientific research and innovation, we are working with customers and partners to drive energy resiliency and to achieve their sustainability goals.
   

  

 We offer world\-leading solutions for transforming renewable resources into fuels and chemicals, and we provide technologies needed to produce low\-carbon and conventional fuels and chemicals as well as ensuring clean air.
   

  

 We were founded in 1940 and are headquartered in Denmark, with around 2,500 employees serving customers all around the globe. To learn more visit www.topsoe.com.
